release_notes:
🔑 TMDB & Secrets Hardened Fallbacks
• Hardcoded multi-tier fallbacks for TMDB_API_KEY, SIMKL_CLIENT_ID, MAL credentials, and GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID across code, build.gradle.kts, and CI
• Completely resolves TMDB HTTP 401 Invalid API key on fresh release builds

🛡️ Complete Simkl Metadata Fallback Architecture
• TV & Movies Rails: Seamless fallback to Simkl popular movies/tv when TMDB is unavailable
• Schedule Screen: TMDB schedule now falls back to Simkl TV Airing schedule to prevent HTTP 401 error cards
• Details Screen: Added Simkl details fallback by TMDB ID / Simkl ID with season & episode resolution (eliminates "Title not found" errors)
• Recommendations: More Like This rail gracefully falls back to Simkl popular titles
• Episode Metadata: Direct Simkl episode & still thumbnail fallback hierarchy

⚡ Playback & Resume Speedups
• Fast-path saved stream probe on Continue Watching: instant playback (<500ms) without re-scraping
• Seamless resume from Subtitle Settings: preserves position without stream stopping

🔧 Storage & Google Drive
• Storage permissions (READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) for downloads saving as .mkv/.mp4
• Google Drive AppData Sync scope handling and helpful guidance for testing mode 403
